456.issue_title: Compact actionable tool summaries in presentation responses

cycles.name: Runtime tool assembly and supported catalog

deliverables.description: One ToolAssembly exposes immutable supported_tools, active_tools, and derived supported_contracts tuples from one authoritative composition-root construction path.
Each supported contract resolves exactly one non-empty tool name and Pydantic output model; empty/duplicate names and unresolved or conflicting explicit/generic output models fail deterministically.

Active tools are an object subset of supported tools; token-enabled activation covers the supported set and tokenless activation preserves the existing credential-free subset without a separately maintained count/name catalog.
Supported-but-inactive tool construction performs no external work; the existing lazy GitHub boundary and tokenless startup remain intact.
Focused tests cover both settings variants and every assembly invariant through the public bootstrap/assembly contract.

cycles.exit_criteria: One assembly owns supported and active objects; every supported output model resolves; tokenless startup succeeds; invalid identity/subset cases fail with actionable context; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass. Stop on external-work construction, a separately maintained catalog, or broader metadata/capability requirements.

cycles.name: Presentation configuration and complete-catalog alignment

deliverables.description: Frozen schema represents recursive direct-child collections, enum cases, list/tuple scalar sequences, one per-tool max_items, omission/truncation wording, and the global byte ceiling.

Startup alignment recursively validates direct fields, list/tuple item categories, placeholders, duplicate siblings, enum cases, max_items use, and mandatory-tail budget against every supported output model.
Alignment enforces deterministic bidirectional supported-catalog/config parity while accepting valid inactive templates and rejecting missing, unknown, or obsolete keys.
Global presentation.yaml values supply the 8,000-byte ceiling and all generic omission/truncation wording without adding tool-specific Python policy.
Durable schema/alignment tests cover representative flat, scalar-sequence, model-collection, nested, enum, list, and tuple declarations plus every designed startup rejection category.

cycles.exit_criteria: All current supported contracts and bundled keys match; inactive templates are accepted; every supported output model is validated; invalid declarations fail with deterministic tool/path context; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass. Stop on active-only catalog truth, skipped models, alignment-owned construction, or tool-name dispatch.

cycles.name: Generic ordered-sequence and collection presentation

deliverables.description: One shared classifier recognizes only concrete scalar/model list[T] and tuple[T, ...] shapes for both alignment and rendering.
SafeNoneFormatter generically renders bounded flat scalar lists/tuples with configured separators, omission count, and None behavior.
CollectionTextRenderer renders scalar/model lists and tuples, siblings, and direct-child nesting depth-first in authoritative DTO order.
Empty, exact-limit, over-limit, None, multibyte, list, tuple, sibling, and nested behavior has durable public-contract coverage.
Missing fields, non-list/tuple containers, and wrongly typed items raise ConfigError with usable field/path and item-index context.
Source and tests prove there is no tool/DTO dispatch, sorting, filtering, model-sequence Python repr, or arbitrary-iterable acceptance.

cycles.exit_criteria: Generic public behavior preserves order and bounds for list/tuple values at every configured depth, avoids Python repr and special cases, and raises path-rich ConfigError for every malformed runtime shape; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass.

cycles.name: UTF-8 text budget enforcement

deliverables.description: TextBudgetLimiter returns under-budget content byte-for-byte unchanged and caps every overflow result at max_text_response_bytes.
Overflow reserves the complete cache reference and correct configured notice before retaining body content.
Truncation preserves UTF-8 code points, prefers complete blocks/lines, and closes an intersected fenced block.
Cache-unavailable truncation remains bounded without claiming that complete detail was cached.
Boundary tests cover under, exact, over, mandatory-tail, multibyte, fenced Markdown, and cache-unavailable cases.

cycles.exit_criteria: Every limiter result is valid UTF-8 and within budget; under-budget text is identical; available URI and notice survive; cache-failure text is truthful; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass.

cycles.name: TextPresenter composition

deliverables.description: TextPresenter assembles scalar text, enum cases, configured collections, instructions, notes, sanitized fallback, reserved cache reference, and the final limiter in the approved order.
Bootstrap injects/composes the new helpers once and decorates/registers only ToolAssembly.active_tools; alignment still receives complete supported contracts.
Under-budget legacy-compatible templates remain byte-for-byte unchanged; over-budget output changes only through the universal limiter.
Server/pipeline evidence proves cached DTOs remain complete and separately embedded validation resources are not counted in the text ceiling.
Presenter source and tests contain no tool-name, output-DTO-type, or validation-record-type dispatch.

cycles.exit_criteria: The generic pipeline works end to end; complete supported alignment remains distinct from active registration; cache evidence is unchanged; a retained compact template is stable below the ceiling; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass. Stop on ResponsePresenter/cache changes or any special-case dispatch.

cycles.name: Atomic structured DTO and dependent-template migration

deliverables.description: WorkflowStateStatus represents available, missing, unreadable, and invalid-phase states; GetWorkContextTool emits structured state/supporting data and no warning/recovery prose.

The existing canonical ValidationIssue becomes the single frozen serializable record; ValidationService aggregates ordered records and ArtifactManager/SafeEditTool forward the same records without formatting, parsing, copying, or field mapping.
SafeEditOutput.issues is the canonical record tuple and its template uses the generic bounded model-collection mechanism with message, severity, line, column, and code.
RunTestsOutput exposes numeric duration_seconds; PytestRunner parses it without producing presentation wording and summary_line is removed.
All seven approved duplicate presentation fields and their producer writes are removed without aliases or dual writes.
Every template affected by C_STRUCTURED.1–5 moves atomically to structured fields and passes complete-catalog startup alignment at cycle exit.

Durable public-contract tests cover enum outcomes, canonical record identity/value propagation through both consumers, optional validation locations/codes, numeric/missing duration, removed-field absence, cache serialization, and immutability.
Config validation, input validation, and explicit template-validation tools retain their existing separate DTOs and responsibilities.

cycles.exit_criteria: All structured contracts and dependent templates load together; the same canonical validation records reach both consumers; every approved obsolete field is absent; startup alignment, focused tests, and file-scoped gates pass. Stop on a second issue DTO, mapping/parsing, presenter type dispatch, compatibility bridge, or unrelated validation redesign.

cycles.name: Complete 50-tool projection rollout

deliverables.description: All 50 supported tool templates implement or explicitly retain the approved inline/cache-only target from the field audit.
One structural matrix proves all 29 tools declare every required inline scalar sequence, root/child collection, item contract, and limit from Design Section 3.8.
get_work_context, get_issue, and get_pr expose the three approved scalar expansions; issue labels use bounded generic sequence formatting.
run_quality_gates and validate_template use outcome-neutral completion wording and expose their actual result as data.
Representative run_tests and run_quality_gates summaries expose bounded actionable rows while excluding traceback, stderr, and verbose gate details.
get_project_plan renders its nested phase/task association in DTO order; list and tuple projections use the same generic behavior.
Complete supported-catalog/config parity and recursive output-model alignment pass for token-enabled and tokenless settings; valid inactive keys remain accepted.
Cached DTOs remain complete, each cache-only decision matches an approved rationale category, and source inspection finds no tool/DTO dispatch.
A template explicitly retained by the audit remains byte-for-byte stable below budget and limiter-only different above it.

cycles.exit_criteria: All 50 audit rows and all 29 mechanics rows are closed; both settings variants start; exact supported/config parity passes; diagnostic outputs are actionable and bounded; cache authority is intact; focused tests and file-scoped gates pass. Stop on unapproved field classification, static catalog, special-case rendering, or new DTO/cache/transport behavior.

cycles.name: Obsolete documentation-test removal

deliverables.description: tests/documentation/test_c4_doc_alignment.py is absent.
tests/documentation/test_agent_instruction_search_contract.py is absent.
All 62 collected cases disappear without replacement mutable-prose tests.

cycles.exit_criteria: Both obsolete modules and all 62 cases are absent; no replacement prose snapshots or unrelated changes exist; no artificial RED was created.

Run one workspace-wide test suite and record exact totals.
Run branch-wide quality gates once and inspect the cached structured result.

Record evidence for supported/active assembly invariants, tokenless startup, exact complete-catalog parity, 8,000-byte enforcement, cache-URI retention, list/tuple order and limits, all 29 mechanics, nested plan, labels, enum warnings, canonical SafeEdit issues, numeric test duration, removed-field absence, semantic outcomes, all 50 audit rows, retained-template compatibility, and complete cached DTOs.
Carry the structured quality-gate findings gap into validation.md for Ready/PR triage.

Correct active discovery, project, GitHub, quality, scaffolding, and tools-overview claims affected by richer inline summaries.
